definitions.explanation: Slow in speed or pace. Used mostly in loanword compounds and in sports, rarely on its own where Japanese would say {遅|おそ}い or ゆっくり.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧スローで⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They replay the goal in slow motion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{忙|いそが}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧、⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧スローな⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more people, tired of the rush of the city, are starting a slower life in the countryside.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スローモーション: slow motion (often shortened to スロー: スロー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧)
- スローペース: a slow pace
- スローライフ: a slow, unhurried lifestyle
- スローボール: a slow pitch (baseball)

WATCH OUT:
スロー is also the loanword for "throw" (スローイン, a throw-in), which is pronounced the same; the compound makes clear which is meant.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: slow, late; the everyday adjective
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧: slowly, leisurely; the everyday adverb
